common_rules.limb_count: 2 arms + 2 hands for both D and E

D.arms: both tucked close into lower/front ribbon; hands may be partly visible

E.body: upright tilted triangular ribbon; slightly more buoyant than D
E.arms: both tucked close to side/lower ribbon; hands may be partly visible

D.arms: both retained; one may lightly brace/support front form, other tucked

E.arms: both retained; one opens slightly, other tucked

D.arms: one hand can support cheek/chin; other remains visible or occluded but accounted for

E.arms: one hand may touch side/chin region; other tucked

D.body: stable explain orientation; small rhythmic response only
D.arms: one low-amplitude explanatory gesture, one tucked
D.face: mouth driven by real audio activity

E.body: more directional explain tilt than D but same amplitude ceiling
E.arms: one outward explanatory gesture, one tucked
E.face: mouth driven by real audio activity

D.arms: two-arm anatomy preserved; one soft open support gesture, one close

E.body: energy damped; less bounce than normal
E.arms: one soft open support gesture, one close

D.arms: both may open wider but stay compact

E.body: slightly quicker positive lift/tilt then settle
E.arms: both may open wider; same two-hand anatomy

GREETING_WAVE.rule: one hand waves; opposite arm/hand remains present and anatomically accounted for

POINTING.rule: use one existing hand/arm; never spawn a new limb
